analysis.title: Russell 2k Futures: Mixed Flows Surrounding Recent Credit Concerns (2)
key_insights: Commitment of Traders data covering the onset of High Yield credit concerns shows Asset Managers reversing in Russell 2k futures. They sold $2.2bn from October 6th to 13th while CDX High Yield rose 9bps and the Russell 2k Index lost 1.7%.
The Asset Manager selling ended a 6 week stretch of purchases totaling $4.8bn. Liquidation ($1.6bn) was the main driver of the October 6th-13th selling.
Non-Dealer net positioning rose despite Asset Manager selling. Hedge Funds bought $1.9bn, Other bought $160mm and Non-Reportable bought $700mm.
High Yield credit kept deteriorating after the CFTC data window. CDX High Yield widened another 10bps from October 13th to 21st.

Sentiment in Russell 2k stayed stable over the 6 sessions to October 21st. Russell 2k outperformed its peers, funding traded flat in outright and relative terms, and normalized 25 delta put-call skew cheapened.
US 10 year real yields (USGGT10Y) fell 11bps to roughly a 1 month low, easing the interest rate burden on small cap companies. GS suggests this likely provided some solace.
Other equity growth barometers are weakening. GS's Cyclicals vs Defensives basket dropped about 5% over the past 2 weeks, raising the question of whether stable Russell 2k sentiment will persist.

macro_indicators.reading: Down 11bps to approximately a 1 month low
macro_indicators.interpretation: Lower real yields reduce the interest rate burden on small cap companies and likely supported Russell 2k sentiment despite wider credit spreads.

risk_factors: High Yield credit continues to widen (CDX HY +10bps October 13th-21st) while Russell 2k sentiment stays stable, a possible divergence.
Equity growth barometers are worsening: GS Cyclicals vs Defensives basket fell about 5% in two weeks.
Stable Russell 2k sentiment leans on the real yield retracement, which may not persist.

Russell 2k 3 month funding was flat in outright and relative terms over the same 6 sessions.
CDX High Yield widened 9bps October 6th-13th and a further 10bps October 13th-21st.
